quotations.projectDescription: Single Storey Rear Extension creating an enlarged Kitchen and a new Dining Room, Internal Alterations to the existing Lounge and Dining Room, and refurbishment of the First Floor Bathroom and En-Suite.

lineItems.itemDescription:
1. A free, no obligation on-site design consultation meeting.
2. Includes discussion of the brief, the proposed extension footprint, and the available planning routes.

1. Full measured building survey of BOTH the Ground Floor and First Floor.
2. Both floors are required because the internal wall removals will need new beams, and the Structural Engineer must establish what bears onto the walls being altered.
3. Includes travel to and from site.

lineItems.description: Laser Scan Registration & Drone Image Processing
lineItems.itemDescription:
1. Processing of the laser scan data and drone image set already captured on site.
2. Scan registration and photogrammetry alignment to produce an accurate base for the existing conditions model.

1. Full three dimensional model of the existing property, both floors.
2. Forms the base model for all subsequent design work and for the TrueVision experience.

1. Development of the rear extension design, including the relationship to the existing Bay Window and the retained half of the building.
2. Massing, roof form and rear elevation glazing studies.

lineItems.description: Internal Layout Development : Kitchen, Dining & Living
lineItems.itemDescription:
1. Development of the enlarged Kitchen layout, retaining the hob and cooker on the existing wall as requested.
2. Island layout and circulation testing to maximise food preparation space and provide breakfast seating.
3. Testing of the internal glazed sliding door position between the Lounge and existing Dining Room.
4. Assessment of whether a casual seating and television area can be accommodated within the extension.
